scope: Fresh matched native N versus trajectory-tangent helper T; both start at the same trajectory-aligned requested yaw. Raw geometric targets remain the primary objective; no tuning or automatic adoption.

clock.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
clock.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

heading_benefit.definition: Each T phase must reduce raw geometric-tangent wrapped heading-error RMS and physical world-z rate tracking RMS to the raw planar tangent yaw-rate by at least20percent over[3,45]s versus matchedN. Because body is tilted, world-z angular velocity is NOT Euler yaw derivative; this rate metric is the helper-control objective/proxy, not exact orientation-rate tracking. Exact Euler yaw-rate tracking is separately reported.
heading_benefit.raw_target_policy: Planned S geometric tangent at zero speed; start/end tangent retained in both holds. Desired heading/rate never follow measured drift.
heading_benefit.shaped_target_policy: Report raw-to-command target lag and actual-to-command tracking separately; shaped target never replaces raw primary objective.

helper_activity.definition: Count actual held intervals with norm of recorded native heading_command[:3] at least threshold. Record original helper eligibility and lever/load masks separately.
helper_activity.limitation: This is helper activity before fade/clipping, not a full applied-command counterfactual. Actual clipping and fade are reported separately.

settling.scope: Descriptive original4conditions and original4 plus raw final geometric heading error<=10degrees. No allphase settling-only adoption claim.

hard_contracts: All six episodes complete45s, finite physicalstate/held commands, no declaredphysicalfailure, applied=clip(requested), caps and actualpriorhistory valid.
